title: 第14章回城-《穿越60带着空间当保安》
content:
第(1/3)页

    王野思索片刻郑重的说：“太爷爷，爷爷奶奶，就现在的政策而言，这三十箱宝贝可不是什么好东西。”

    “这东西是催命符，古玩珠宝都不值钱，四九城的遗老遗少们天天晚上拿着去黑市换粮食，黄金就更不行了，国家不许交易。按现在的发展趋势，可能以后会更严重。三五年内够点呛恢复正常。”

    这王野都是往短了说的，要知道恢复正常得二十年后。

    王野说道：“太爷爷，爷爷奶奶，这些东西就在下面埋着，谁也别说。等将来能弄出来时我再想办法弄走，平均分给二叔和三叔家。现在一件都不能拿出来，这要是让人顺藤摸瓜找到这里，咱后悔都没地方哭。”

    太爷爷、爷爷奶奶想了一下，都觉得王野说的在理，太爷爷一脸欣慰的道：“都听我重孙孙的，你家那三个货一看就不太机灵。以后咱王家还得我重孙孙当家。”

    爷爷也赞同：“行，听爹的，大富大贵不指望，平平安安才是福。”

    爷爷、奶奶和太爷爷他们都是从战乱中存活下来的。对于生活有自己认知。要是一个个傻了吧唧的，王家也不会没有什么伤亡就度过这么多年的战乱。

    太爷爷对王野说：“重孙孙，你要是有办法，最好把这些东西全都弄走，弄到一个只有你自己知道的地方。不行就在山里找个山洞，一点一点的运走。这东西在下面，我和你爷爷奶奶总是不放心。”

    王野想了一下：“太爷爷，这样，今天晚上，咱们把这些箱子运到山边那个小山洞里，我明天等人们都上工了，再把这些东西运到山深处。找一个山洞藏好，再把山洞口一堵，神不知鬼不觉。”

    太爷爷点头道：“好，就这样，现在先把东西刨出了。”

    就这样，两老一小折腾到半夜，把三十个箱子刨了出来。王野用精神力扫一下，十箱大洋，五箱黄金，五箱古董，十箱珍贵药材。所有的东西都被油纸一层层的包着，箱子也做了防水处理。

    接下来就是运出去了。王野拉着板车，一趟六个箱子，拉了五趟，眼看到了后半夜才都运到小山洞。王野也没回家，就在小山洞守着。

    王野让爷爷奶奶回家了，等爷爷奶奶走远，王野把三十个箱子收进空间。就在小山洞睡着了。一觉睡到第二天中午。又在山上锻炼了一下午。到了四点多钟才回到爷爷家。

    太爷爷看到重孙孙回来，关切的问：“都放好了？”

    王野笑着说：“放心吧！太爷爷，就是有人把整座山翻过来也找不到。”

    太爷爷一脸严肃的说：“记住了，重孙孙，就算是被人找到了，也和咱家没关系。”

    王野郑重的点头：“好嘞！太爷爷，我记住了！”

    本来今天要回城的，算了，明天再走吧！爷爷奶奶没下工呢，王野就又去做了一顿丰盛的晚饭。炖了两只兔子，两只野鸡。

    今天想着把大叔小叔两家也叫过来一起吃顿饭。到了下工的时候一家人回到家，聚到一起全都吃的五饱六饱。

    等二位叔叔两家走了后，爷爷才问了王野箱子的事儿，然后爷爷也说了和太爷爷一样的话。从这点看，在爷爷奶奶、太爷爷心里，家人的平安是无价的，远比那些珠宝价值高。

    第二天吃过早饭，王野就要回家。奶奶非要王野带走一半的肉食，这王野能同意吗？空间里的肉多了！最后好说歹说，连哄带威胁的，才答应带着两只兔子、两只鸡回去。

    王野把东西装进麻袋，在爷爷奶奶和太爷爷的注视下走了。王野出村的时候，专门绕路去跟三爷爷打声招呼，三爷爷又给王野拿了一罐子野猪熬的荤油。这东西现在可是重礼了。就这一罐子荤油，就是下聘娶媳妇都够用了。

    出了村子，到了一个没人的地方，把东西收进空间。一路边走边玩，走了两个多小时才看见城门，找了个没人的地方，把麻袋从空间中取了出来。又把一头四十来斤的小野猪放进袋子。扛着麻袋低着头，在一路人的目光下回到南锣鼓巷。

    回到家里，王江河和王笑笑正在院子里和一群小孩儿在玩儿。一进门，王江河就看见王野背着一个大麻袋：“大哥，大哥，你回来了。”

    王笑笑听见二哥在叫大哥，也不玩儿了。倒腾着两条小短腿儿跑向王野。

    王野赶紧放下袋子，伸开双手抱住飞奔而来的小妹妹，王笑笑刚扑进王野怀里，小嘴一撅，就哭了起来：“大锅，大锅......”趴在王野肩上就开始抽噎。

    嘴里还大锅大锅的叫个不停。王野轻轻的拍着小丫头的后背哄着小丫头轻声的说：“嗷嗷嗷，不哭嗷，大哥这不是回来了吗，不哭嗷。”

    秦婉听见院里的动静也从屋里出来。看见王野抱着妹妹也走上前。笑着对王野说：“大儿子回来啦！这小丫头片子可是想你想的厉害。这几天都哭了好几次了。”

    王笑笑好像是听懂了母亲的话。抱王野的手更用力了，好像一松手大哥就又走了。
    第(1/3)页

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Wang Ye thought for a moment and said solemnly: "Grandpa, grandparents, according to the current policy, these thirty boxes of treasures are not a good thing."

"This thing is a talisman. Antiques and jewelry are not worth anything. The old and young people in Sijiu City take it to the black market every night to exchange for food. Gold is even worse. The country does not allow trading. According to the current development trend, it may become more serious in the future. It will be enough to return to normal within three to five years."

Wang Ye is talking about this in the short term. You must know that it will take twenty years for things to return to normal.

Wang Ye said: "Grandpa, grandparents, these things are buried down there, don't tell anyone. When they can be found in the future, I will find a way to get them away and divide them equally between the second uncle and third uncle's families. Now I can't take out any of them. If someone follows the clues and finds this place, we will regret it and have no place to cry."

Grandpa and grandpa thought about it for a while and felt that what Wang Ye said was reasonable. Grandpa said with a pleased look on his face: "Listen to my great-grandson. Those three guys in your family are not very clever at first sight. From now on, my great-grandson will still have to be the head of our Wang family."

Grandpa also agreed: "Okay, listen to dad, don't expect to be rich and powerful, peace and security are the blessings."

Grandpa, grandma and great-grandfather all survived the war.Have your own understanding of life.If everyone was stupid, the Wang family would not have survived so many years of war without casualties.

Grandpa said to Wang Ye: "Great-grandson, if you have a way, you'd better get all these things away and put them in a place that only you know. If not, find a cave in the mountains and transport them away bit by bit. Your grandparents and I are always worried about these things down there."

Wang Ye thought for a moment: "Grandpa, let's transport these boxes to the small cave on the side of the mountain tonight. I will wait until everyone gets to work tomorrow, and then transport these things to the depths of the mountain. Find a cave to hide them, and then block the entrance of the cave so that no one can notice."

Grandpa nodded and said: "Okay, that's it. Let's dig out the things first."

In this way, the two old men and one young man dug out thirty boxes until midnight.Wang Ye scanned it with his mental power and found ten boxes of oceans, five boxes of gold, five boxes of antiques, and ten boxes of precious medicinal materials.Everything was wrapped in layers of oil paper, and the box was waterproofed.

The next step is to transport it out.Wang Ye pulled the cart and pulled six boxes five times at a time. He saw that they were all transported to the small cave in the middle of the night.Wang Ye didn't go home either, so he stayed in the small cave.

Wang Ye let his grandparents go home. When the grandparents left, Wang Ye put thirty boxes into the space.He fell asleep in the small cave.I slept until noon the next day.Another afternoon of exercise in the mountains.It was around four o'clock before I returned to my grandfather's house.

When my great-grandfather saw his great-grandchildren come back, he asked with concern: "Have they been put away?"

Wang Ye smiled and said, "Don't worry! Grandpa, even if someone turns the whole mountain over, they won't be able to find it."

Grandpa said with a serious face: "Remember, great-grandchildren, even if they are found, they have nothing to do with our family."

Wang Ye nodded solemnly: "Okay! Grandpa, I remember it!"

I was going back to the city today, forget it, let’s leave tomorrow!Grandpa and grandma didn't get off work, so Wang Ye made another sumptuous dinner.Two rabbits and two pheasants were stewed.

Today I’m thinking of calling my uncle and his family over to have a meal together.When it was time to get off work, the family returned home and gathered together to eat a full meal.

After the two uncles and their families left, grandpa asked Wang Ye about the box, and then grandpa said the same thing as great-grandpa.From this point of view, in the hearts of grandparents and great-grandfathers, the safety of the family is priceless, far more valuable than those jewelry.

After breakfast the next day, Wang Ye was going home.Grandma insists that Wang Ye take away half of the meat. Can Wang Ye agree?There’s a lot of meat in the space!Finally, after coaxing and threatening, he agreed to go back with two rabbits and two chickens.

Wang Ye put the things into a sack and left under the watchful eyes of his grandparents and great-grandfather.When Wang Ye left the village, he made a special detour to say hello to Third Grandpa. Third Grandpa brought Wang Ye a jar of wild boar meat oil.This thing is a big gift now.Just this jar of meat oil is enough to hire a wife.

After leaving the village, I went to a deserted place and put my things into the space.I walked and played for more than two hours before I saw the city gate. I found a deserted place and took the sack out of the space.Then he put a small wild boar weighing about 40 pounds into the bag.Carrying the sack and lowering his head, he returned to Nanluogu Lane under the eyes of passers-by.

Back home, Wang Jianghe and Wang Xiaoxiao were playing with a group of children in the yard.As soon as he entered the door, Wang Jianghe saw Wang Ye carrying a large sack: "Brother, brother, you are back."

Wang Xiaoxiao stopped playing when he heard his second brother calling him eldest brother.He ran towards Wang Ye on his two short legs.

Wang Ye quickly put down the bag and stretched out his arms to hug the little sister who was running towards her. As soon as Wang Xiaoxiao threw herself into Wang Ye's arms, she pouted her mouth and started crying: "Big pot, big pot..." Lying on Wang Ye's shoulder, she started sobbing.

He kept shouting with a big pot in his mouth.Wang Ye gently patted the little girl's back and coaxed the little girl to say softly: "Ouch, don't cry, eldest brother is back, don't cry."

Qin Wan heard the noise in the courtyard and came out of the house.Seeing Wang Ye holding his sister in his arms, he also stepped forward.He smiled and said to Wang Ye: "The eldest son is back! This little girl misses you so much. She has cried several times in the past few days."

Wang Xiaoxiao seemed to understand what her mother said.The hand holding Wang Ye became harder, as if the big brother would leave again as soon as he let go.
